Your learning path

Start with the reports. End with evidence.

  1. Build the mapUnderstand the accounting equation and reporting context.
  2. Read the coreIncome, balance sheet, and cash flow—together.
  3. Investigate the evidenceNotes, audit, management narrative, and segments.
  4. Apply your judgementWork through an unfamiliar report in the capstone.
